references.title: Ribbe, Megaw, Ferguson, Taylor and Traill (1969), The albite structures, Acta Crystallographica B25, 1503-1518
references.notes: COD CC0; low albite, conventional C-centered cell. Space group C-1 (No. 2).

references.title: Mineral Data Publishing, Albite, version 1
references.notes: Publicly readable; accessed 2026-09-19. Used as a factual citation only; the source distinguishes vitreous crystal luster from pearly cleavage surfaces.

provenance.derivation: Habit form selections use standard pinacoidal indices in the conventional feldspar cell basis. Development values, disabled forms, and preferred views are curated visualization choices, not measured growth parameters. The declared standard setting selects the core registry basis.

Appearance presets use curated visualization parameters (base color, roughness, metalness, transmission, IOR, absorption color and density) selected to represent common albite varieties. Values are not measured optical constants.

appearanceClaims.description: Albite occurs white to gray, with bluish, greenish, or reddish colour reported.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Colour range describes mineral appearance and does not define a measured renderer colour.

appearanceClaims.description: Albite is reported as transparent to translucent.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Diaphaneity does not directly determine the curated transmission value.

appearanceClaims.description: Albite has vitreous luster, typically pearly on cleavage surfaces.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: The general luster observation has no growth-face selector.

appearanceClaims.description: Albite cleavage surfaces are typically pearly.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Cleavage observations must not select generated growth faces.

appearanceClaims.description: Polysynthetic twinning can produce striae on {001} or {010} surfaces.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Twinning and its surface-origin semantics are not yet represented by the morphology renderer.

habits.name: Tabular
habits.description: Flattened parallel to {010}; pinacoid {010} dominant with {001} and {110} bounding the edges.

habits.name: Prismatic
habits.description: Elongated blocky habit with {110} and {1-10} prisms more developed; {010} and {001} subordinate.
